text_block_list.text:
"Tomorrow is finally Satono Diamond's 
first GⅠ race, the Satsuki Sho."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I put them in my bag. I haven't 
forgotten my shoes, including the spares.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Of course, my shoes are already fitted. 
...Trainer, please calm down."

I intended to calm her down, but she ended 
up soothing me instead.
(Bzzzzz...)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Oh, an incoming call... It looks like a 
phone call. Please excuse me for a moment.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hello, Father? Yes, I am doing very well—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me for interrupting your 
conversation.
choice_data_list:
Was that a call from your parents cheering 
you on?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes. ...Ehehe! Because Father 
double-checks if I forgot anything, just 
like you do, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Before a race, everyone around me always 
seems more restless than I am.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"...Even when I told them, 'I will surely 
bring you victory,' they just told me that 
running without getting hurt was enough."
choice_data_list: I think that's how they truly feel too.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Neither Father nor Mother have 
ever ordered me to "win." They treat me 
with the gentle warmth of parents.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
That is precisely why... I want to win 
tomorrow's race.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
As their daughter, I shall become a 
"Legendary Umamusume" and dedicate our 
family's long-sought, very first glory to 
my parents.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Despite their busy schedules, both Father 
and Mother have devoted themselves to the 
development of the Umamusume world.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
So, I think a "reward" for all that hard 
work is well-deserved, don't you think?♪
choice_data_list: We've gotta deliver the best reward ever!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I will absolutely achieve the Satono 
family's first GⅠ victory!

We fire ourselves up once more for victory 
in the Satsuki Sho. I have high hopes for 
her first GⅠ triumph.

—However, as if to pour cold water on our 
spirits, the weather forecast on the TV 
delivered some ominous news.
choice_data_list:
They say there's gonna be a storm 
tomorrow……

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
It appears so. But don't worry! We've 
prepared measures for heavy track 
conditions!

Satono Diamond gives a reassuring reply. 
Just to be safe, I decided we should leave 
Tracen Academy early tomorrow.

The next morning—the rain wasn't too 
heavy. However, a fierce wind blew 
relentlessly.

It looked like the strong winds would 
suspend train services. Thinking ahead, I 
decided to take a taxi to Nakayama 
Racecourse.

However, severe traffic backed up on the 
highway due to the bad weather. Even past 
our scheduled arrival time, we still 
couldn't get off the highway—

Even after taking local roads, the traffic 
jam continued. At this rate, we're going 
to be late...!
choice_data_list:
We have no choice but to get out of the 
car and run to the racetrack!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes! I'll head on ahead!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ugh...! Such strong wind...!

A wind so fierce it almost knocked Satono 
Diamond off her feet. A spring storm, 
unusual for this time of year. To think it 
would get us stuck in traffic and nearly 
make us late—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(A rare storm... traffic jams... Why did 
everything have to go wrong today of all 
days...?)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (...Could it be...... a jinx?)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(At this rate, even running is in 
jeopardy... And this agitation will 
disrupt my running...!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(Is this jinx trying to block my path to 
becoming a "legendary Umamusume"...?!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(...! In that case, I can't afford to 
lose!!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: *Gaaaasp*!

No sooner had she shouted than Satono 
Diamond sprinted down the Umamusume-only 
lane at breakneck speed.

I arrived at Nakayama Racecourse just 
thirty minutes before the scheduled post 
time for the Satsuki Sho.

Please let me make it in time— I head 
towards the paddock, praying under my 
breath.
Satono Diamond was nowhere to be seen...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...Phew...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes, made it just in the nick of time!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
My pace got thrown off a little, but... it 
actually helped me calm down instead!

Satono Diamond smiled brightly. Time and 
again, her mental fortitude never ceases 
to amaze.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The first leg of the Classic Triple 
Crown... I definitely cannot afford to 
lose!!

As if answering her determination, the 
rain clouds cleared away before we knew 
it, and dazzling sunlight poured down.
